name: Ishamuhale
summary: At Camp Taurajo, Jorn Skyseer sends you to face Ishamuhale, the fiercest sunscale raptor in the Barrens. The hunt tests your skill and respect for nature's deadliest predators.

sections.title: The Nature of Speartooth
sections.body: Sunscale raptors hunt the Barrens in cunning, vicious packs, but none inspires more dread than Speartooth. Jorn Skyseer says Ishamuhale kills by instinct and passion, not for food or territory. He hunts because killing is his nature. To face him is to test whether you can withstand a predator's unbridled ferocity.

sections.title: Baiting the Beast
sections.body: Ishamuhale will not be found resting in a nest. To draw him out, you follow the plains' natural rhythm. Jorn tells you to kill a fresh zhevra and carry its carcass to a lone, withered dead tree on the plains northwest of Ratchet. The scent of blood on the arid wind brings Ishamuhale swiftly to claim his prey.

sections.title: The Burden of Strength
sections.body: When you bring Ishamuhale's fang back to Camp Taurajo, Jorn Skyseer sees it as a profound spiritual milestone, not merely a sign of victory. Tauren belief holds that overcoming so fierce a predator lets you absorb some of its raw strength. The test then turns inward: you must carry that might with temperance, honor, and restraint, rather than surrender to blind bloodlust.

faq.answer: Ishamuhale, known as Speartooth, is an exceptionally fierce sunscale raptor prowling the Barrens. He hunts relentlessly from instinct and passion, not merely from hunger.
To lure Ishamuhale out, you need a freshly slain zhevra. Hang its carcass at the designated dead tree northwest of Ratchet, the goblin port, and its scent will draw him from hiding.

faq.q: Where does this quest start and end?
faq.answer: Jorn Skyseer, a tauren hunter, gives you this hunt at Camp Taurajo in the southern Barrens. After you slay Ishamuhale, you return his fang to Jorn at the camp.

faq.q: Why does Jorn Skyseer want Ishamuhale dead?
faq.answer: Jorn does not seek Ishamuhale's extermination out of malice. Tracking and besting him is a spiritual trial that tests you against nature's raw aggression and teaches temperance in bearing such ferocity.
After you prove yourself against Ishamuhale, Jorn directs you toward greater threats disturbing the Barrens' balance. The next hunt concerns the Enraged Thunder Lizards to the south.

faq.q: How does this quest fit into Sergra Darkthorn's chain?
faq.answer: Ishamuhale continues the grand hunting trials begun by Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads. After you prove your skill in the northern plains, Sergra sends you south to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo to face apex beasts.

angles.text: As a tauren hunter, you learn that taking a mighty predator's life calls for discipline to control the fierce spirit you inherit.
As a hunter, you use fresh bait and terrain to draw an elusive predator out, practicing the patient, cunning art of the stalk.
As a member of the Horde, you prove your worth by facing a legendary menace like Ishamuhale and make the roads between Ratchet and Taurajo marginally safer for Horde travelers.
